name: Corpus Christi

routes.outcome: Official City of Corpus Christi Development Services GIS/address viewer. The page describes an address and tax-ID search and states that its GIS data is informational and approximate.

Official Nueces Central Appraisal District site identifies responsibility for real and business personal property in Nueces County, lists Corpus Christi among its taxing entities, and links an Interactive Map.

Public ArcGIS REST group layer page identifies NUECES COUNTY and a Parcels (2024) sublayer; supported query formats include JSON, geoJSON, and PBF. Page reports native spatial reference 102740 (2278).

Public ArcGIS REST parcel-layer page identifies polygon geometry, max record count 2000, supported geoJSON, and fields including OBJECTID, Prop_ID, GEO_ID, and many unsafe owner/address/value fields. Only safe identity candidates were considered for a query; unsafe fields were not requested.
Attempted anonymous metadata request with TLS verification enabled; request timed out after 30 seconds in this environment. The HTML REST layer page above supplied the recorded schema evidence.

Attempted anonymous exact-point and bounded-envelope GeoJSON queries using WGS84 input, intersects, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3, and outFields=OBJECTID,Prop_ID. The request path timed out after 30 seconds; no feature count, identity, or geometry was inferred.

schemaAndCrs.nativeCrs: ESRI:102740 / EPSG:2278 as reported by service page
schemaAndCrs.queryCrs: 4326 requested for WUP-coordinate query; no response received

sourceFieldMapping.safeIdentity: Prop_ID or GEO_ID if stable in a returned feature; OBJECTID retained only as legacy-compatible fallback

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point plus approximately 0.008-degree WGS84 envelope around it

sourceFieldMapping.identityProvenance: The service exposes Prop_ID, GEO_ID, and OBJECTID; no returned feature established which is the stable native parcel identity.

localCustodianAssessment: The City of Corpus Christi GIS/address viewer and Nueces Central Appraisal District are local custodians/evidence. The Pape-Dawson ArcGIS service is a public map service linked by search results but is a service host/provider rather than the local governmental custodian. General federal/national mapping results were not used as registry evidence.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if independently confirmed from an anonymous response
full parcel polygon only when bounded and anonymously returned
native CRS and requested output CRS

qualification.reason: Public local GIS custodians and a parcel-layer schema/CRS are evidenced, but the bounded anonymous feature request timed out, so no stable native identity or geometry was independently qualified.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [27.7290358614509,-97.3978332058705] was preserved and not shifted.
A timeout is not evidence of an exact-point miss, map extent miss, or citywide absence.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification exception was used.
The layer page reports a 2024 name but its description says data date March 2019; freshness and update cadence remain uncertain.
This research packet does not admit or integrate a runtime adapter.
uncertainty: The local custodians and public ArcGIS parcel layer are evidenced. Anonymous metadata/feature requests from this environment timed out, leaving feature availability at the WUP point, stable identity selection, citywide coverage, and current geometry unverified. Runtime readiness remains held for serial review.
